fire_when: A coefficient-one proof discards a relative 1+o(1) probability error by passing to the limit while retaining a uniform exponential remainder.
silent_when: The target itself permits 1+o(1), or a separate estimate bounds the coefficient excess uniformly by C exp(-c n).
text: Carry the relative error through the target quantifiers. A 1+o(1) factor can leave excess far above an exponential remainder; identify the extra estimate that removes it before claiming coefficient one.
